node.statement: Fix D, W and one raw call as in node 1, and put q=(1+K_disp)*D*t. The ledger radius inequalities and epsilon_R<=t give epsilon_R<=epsilon_max^cb, D*t<=delta_max^cb, D*t+epsilon_R<=e_it, epsilon_R<=epsilon_unit, K_floor*epsilon_R<=delta_unit, and q<=min{a_unit,1/2}.
